title: 도시철도법 등에 의한 구분지상권 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Registration of Transfer of Sectional Superficies Based on Adjudication of Expropriation)
(1) Where an urban railroad constructor, road management authority, electric utility business entity, agricultural infrastructure improvement project implementer, railroad construction project implementer, regional development project implementer, water supply business entity, electric power source development business entity, or person intending to install public sewerage receives an adjudication expropriating already registered sectional superficies pursuant to the Act on the Acquisition of Land, etc. for Public Works and the Compensation Therefor, that person may independently apply for registration of transfer of sectional superficies on the ground of expropriation of a right, by providing the written adjudication and information evidencing compensation or deposit as attached information. <Amended on July 26, 2004; September 28, 2009; February 2, 2017; January 9, 2019; and October 29, 2021.>
(2) Where an application for registration of transfer of sectional superficies is made pursuant to paragraph (1), if there is registration of a right whose subject matter is the sectional superficies being expropriated, or if registration of transfer of that sectional superficies in the name of a third party has been made after the date of commencement of expropriation, such registration shall be cancelled ex officio. <Amended on September 28, 2009.>
